description.value: Hope Mountain Cafe is a breakfast and lunch destination in Hope, BC, founded in 2018 with a menu inspired by global flavors and fresh, sustainable ingredients. The cafe serves specialty coffee, all-day breakfast, sandwiches, and desserts, positioning itself as a solid full-meal stop for cyclists moving through the Fraser Canyon corridor. Online ordering and takeout are available for those who need to eat on the move.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: wall_loops (10 spaces) at 44m; rack at 96m. Total: 10 spaces.
